contacts.title: τ-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
contacts.read_depth: Abstract and metadata; HTML selected section3 and reward/pass^k paragraphs, lines78-90 and173-180; official README; complete base.py source read, not executed
contacts.claim: Outcome database and necessary response information are independently compared; paper acknowledges reward1 need not satisfy every policy.
contacts.limit: Benchmark domains and explicit tasks are unlike unprompted135M garden; pass^k is all-k consistency, not at-least-one pass@k.

contacts.title: The Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL): From Tool Use to Agentic Evaluation of Large Language Models
contacts.read_depth: PMLR abstract+metadata; V3 official blog introduction, categories, inference and evaluation sections plus error examples; official current test-category docs and directory listing; no scorer implementation audit
contacts.claim: Multi-turn uses state and response-path subset checks, including read-only request coverage. Long-context augmentation and filesystem/current-directory failures are documented.
contacts.limit: Ground-truth minimum paths may miss alternatives or costs; current repository docs and V3 blog are different snapshots, not a pinned replication. No arXiv ID claimed for BFCL.

contacts.title: Executable Code Actions Elicit Better LLM Agents
contacts.read_depth: Abstract+metadata; HTML selected sections2.3–3.2 lines137–200; official full README; Hugging Face card/viewer header and preview rows, not full dataset
contacts.claim: Executable code plus real execution feedback is paired with task verification; interaction training includes recovery trajectories. Released trained agents are7B; HF codeact split shows7.14k rows.
contacts.limit: Interpreter access is not evidence that an untrained-for-this135M model can discover APIs or recover; training/body/task differences dominate transfer.

contacts.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
contacts.read_depth: Abstract+metadata; HTML sections3–4.3 selected lines130–179; official README including oracle/distractor data schemas and prompting paths, not executed
contacts.claim: Controlled position/distractor manipulations separate input availability from use; query placement benefits syntheticKV but not uniformlyQA; scale affects positional trend.
contacts.limit: Not file execution, not repeated self-generated history, and not135M. Fresh-vs-old-history proposal is our derived control, not an already replicated paper result.

referrals.title: CAREFUL-Bench: Effect-Aware, Judge-Free Evaluation of Multi-Turn LLM Function Calling
referrals.status: Forwarded to root for independent counterexample pass; not counted as adopted contact
referrals.caution: Its broad final-state-only description needs reconciliation with BFCLV3 response-based subset checks.

access_failures.status: Tool navigation mismatch, not access denial
access_failures.detail: find on arXiv HTML refs resolved to abstract versions; CodeAct section string not found. Recovered by opening explicit versioned HTML URLs with line positions.
Combined large GitHub README/web output truncated in assistant tool output. Subsequent focused reads used for key claims; no claim of full-paper reading.

Supplied value vs actual file read paired with two hidden nonce files; separate source access, correct value use, parse error and process status.
